text: dsh-memory-lite 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的工作区长期记忆插件，通过注册记忆工具并在新会话提示中加入标题索引，把记忆保存为本地 Markdown 文件。它支持保存、关键词搜索、读取、列出和归档记忆，项目记忆按工作目录隔离，也可使用全局范围；检索对中文按二元组匹配。适合希望跨会话保留偏好、项目决定和常见事实的用户。无需 API 密钥或外部服务，记忆写入本机文件系统。

dsh-memory-lite adds workspace-scoped memory to DeepSeek Harness. Tools save, search, read, list, and archive local Markdown notes; project notes follow the working directory, with optional global notes. A title index can appear in new session prompts. No API key or external service is needed.
我想让 DSH 记住不同项目里的长期信息，切换工作目录时不要混在一起。
有没有办法把常用偏好保存下来，之后的会话还能查到？
I want my DSH sessions to save durable notes locally and find them again by keywords.
dsh-memory-lite 的功能「保存和管理记忆」：用 memory_save 保存记忆，memory_list 列出标题，memory_get 读取内容，memory_forget 将其归档；项目记忆按工作目录隔离。
dsh-memory-lite 的功能「检索并提示已有记忆」：memory_search 按标题、标签和正文关键词排序并返回片段；创建 agent 时可在系统提示中加入受字符预算限制的记忆标题索引。

dsh-memory-lite README · dsh-memory-lite：Long-term memory for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (DSH), scoped by workspace directory. Sessions opened in the same directory share one memory store; sessions in a different directory see none of it, except for memories saved with the `global` scope. Every memory is a plain Markdown file on disk. No network requests, no automatic model calls, no database, no index files.

dsh-memory-lite README · Features：- Five tools: `memory_save`, `memory_search`, `memory_get`, `memory_list`, `memory_forget`
- A short "title index" section injected into the system prompt when a session starts, so the agent knows what exists without reading every file
- Workspace isolation keyed by the normalized working directory
- Plain Markdown with YAML front matter; readable and editable in any text editor
- Archive-on-forget instead of deletion
- Zero network activity, asserted by the test suite

dsh-memory-lite README · Requirements：- DSH Desktop 2.0.18 with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 0.2.1-rc.2 (`engines.dsh` is pinned to `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.2.2`)
- `@deepseek-ai/cordis` 4.0.5
- Node.js >= 20
- pnpm (for building from source)

dsh-memory-lite README · Install：From a local checkout:

```powershell
pnpm install
pnpm build
dsh plugin --profile <name> add <path-to-repo>
```

Or directly from GitHub:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <name> add git+https://github.com/Alexis-ray/dsh-memory-lite.git
```

dsh-memory-lite README · Install：Both forms register the plugin in the profile named by `--profile` (for example `desktop`) and append `dsh-memory-lite` to `dsh.profile.bundles`. Restart the client if a newly created session does not see the `memory_*` tools. Full instructions, including verification, upgrade, and uninstall, are in [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md) (Chinese).

dsh-memory-lite README · Tools：| Tool | Key inputs | Returns | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `memory_save` | `title` (<= 80 chars), `body`, `scope?` (`project` \| `global`), `tags?`, `confidence?` | `id`, `path`, `scope` | Defaults to `project`. Rejects bodies that look like credentials. |
| `memory_search` | `query`, `scope?` (`both` \| `project` \| `global`), `limit?` | hit list with snippets | Lexical scoring: title x3, tags x2, body x1. CJK text is matched as bigrams. Default limit 8, max 50. |
| `memory_get` | `id` | full record | Errors when not found; never returns empty. |
| `memory_list` | `scope?` | title index lines | Titles only; bodies are not read. |
| `memory_forget` | `id` | `archivedPath` | Moves the file to `.archive/`; reversible by moving it back. |
dsh-memory-lite README · Tools：`memory_get` and `memory_forget` only reach memories visible to the current workspace plus `global`; an id from another workspace cannot be read or archived.

dsh-memory-lite README · Workspace isolation：- The project key is `sha256(normalizePath(cwd)).slice(0, 12)`. `normalizePath` lowercases the drive letter, converts `\` to `/`, collapses repeated separators, and drops the trailing separator. Symlinks are not resolved, so renaming a directory means a new project.
- Sessions in the same directory share the same set of project memories.
- Sessions in a different directory cannot see, search, get, or forget those project memories, even by id.
- `global` memories are visible from every workspace. Set `allowGlobalScope: false` to disable writing them.

dsh-memory-lite README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `vaultPath` | `<DSH_HOME>/memory-vault` (or `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\memory-vault` when `DSH_HOME` is unset) | Root directory of the vault |
| `injectStanding` | `true` | Inject the standing title index into the system prompt |
| `standingMaxItems` | `8` | Max entries in the standing section (min 1) |
| `standingBudgetChars` | `1200` | Character budget for the standing section (min 200) |
| `allowGlobalScope` | `true` | Allow `scope: global` in `memory_save` |
| `redactSecrets` | `true` | Reject writes whose body matches credential patterns (`api_key`, `secret`, `password`, `token`, private key blocks) |
| `maxFileBytes` | `65536` | Max size of a single memory file (min 1024) |
| `autoSavePolicy` | `off` | Whether to register a "write policy" system prompt section that nudges the agent to save notable facts proactively. `hint` enables the section; `off` registers nothing. |

dsh-memory-lite README · Configuration：Values are set through the plugin's config in `cordis.patch.yml` (either the file shipped with the plugin, or an id-targeted patch appended to your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`). Keys that are not written fall back to the schema defaults above.

dsh-memory-lite README · On-disk format：The vault is a plain directory:

```
<vault>/
  global/
    <slug>-<id>.md            global memories, visible everywhere
  projects/

One memory is one Markdown file with YAML front matter:

```markdown

dsh-memory-lite README · On-disk format：Writes go through a temp file plus fsync plus rename, so a crash mid-write loses at most that one write and never leaves a truncated memory file. Files over `maxFileBytes` are rejected outright, not truncated. `memory_forget` moves the file into `.archive/` and stamps `archivedAt`; moving it back restores it. There is no index file: listing and search always read the `.md` files directly, so there is nothing to rebuild or corrupt.

dsh-memory-lite README · Design trade-offs：- **No network, ever.** The plugin never calls out. `test/offline.test.ts` stubs `fetch`, `http.request`, `https.request`, `net.connect`, and `dns.lookup` at runtime and asserts zero call attempts.
- **No index, no database.** Everything is derived from the files themselves. Fewer moving parts, nothing to maintain, and any editor can inspect the vault.
- **Archive, don't delete.** Forgetting is reversible, which suits long-lived memories.
- **Lexical search only.** No embeddings. Fewer false recalls at the cost of missing synonyms.
- **Standing section is an index, not content.** The injected text says memories are data, not instructions, and bodies must be fetched with `memory_get`.
- **Built output is committed.** `lib/` ships in the repository so the plugin can be installed straight from git without a build step.

dsh-memory-lite README · Limitations：- Lexical search: no semantic matching, weak on synonyms.
- Renaming a project directory orphans its memories under the old key (they remain on disk; `project.json` records the old path).
- No update tool: replace a memory by saving a new one and forgetting the old.
- No cross-machine sync; the vault is a local directory, sync it yourself if needed.
- `engines.dsh` is pinned to a narrow range; a DSH upgrade outside `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.2.2` skips the bundle until the range is updated (see [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md)).

dsh-memory-lite README · Development：```powershell
pnpm install      # install dependencies
pnpm typecheck    # tsc --noEmit
pnpm test         # vitest run
pnpm build        # tsc -p tsconfig.json -> lib/

dsh-memory-lite README · Development：`test/offline.test.ts` runs the entire plugin with `fetch`, `http.request`, `https.request`, `net.connect`, and `dns.lookup` stubbed, and asserts that none of them was called even once. The other suites cover path normalization and project keys, slug generation, frontmatter round-trips, atomic writes leaving no `.tmp-` residue, archiving, search ranking, cross-workspace denial of `get`/`forget` by id, the tool contracts, and the standing section's 3+5 selection and budget trimming.

dsh-memory-lite README · dsh-memory-lite：[English version](README.md)

给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）用的长期记忆插件，按工作区目录隔离。同一个目录下的会话共享一份记忆；换一个目录默认什么都看不到，只有 `global` 作用域的记忆跨工作区可见。每条记忆就是磁盘上的一个 Markdown 文件：零网络请求、零自动模型调用，没有数据库，也没有索引文件。

dsh-memory-lite README · 特性：- 五个工具：`memory_save`、`memory_search`、`memory_get`、`memory_list`、`memory_forget`
- 会话创建时注入一小段「标题索引」常驻系统提示，agent 不必逐个读文件就知道已有哪些记忆
- 以规范化后的工作目录为键做隔离
- 纯 Markdown 加 YAML front matter，任何编辑器都能直接读写
- 忘记即归档，不做物理删除
- 全程零网络，测试套件里有断言保证

dsh-memory-lite README · 环境要求：- DSH Desktop 2.0.18，`@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 0.2.1-rc.2（`engines.dsh` 锁定 `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.2.2`）
- `@deepseek-ai/cordis` 4.0.5
- Node.js >= 20
- pnpm（从源码构建时需要）

dsh-memory-lite README · 安装：本地目录安装：

```powershell
pnpm install
pnpm build
dsh plugin --profile <name> add <插件目录>
```

或直接从 GitHub 安装：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <name> add git+https://github.com/Alexis-ray/dsh-memory-lite.git
```

两种方式都会把插件注册进 `--profile` 指定的 profile（例如 `desktop`），并追加到 `dsh.profile.bundles`。新开会话看不到 `memory_*` 工具就重启客户端。完整的安装、核对、升级与卸载步骤见 [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md)。

dsh-memory-lite README · 工具：| 工具 | 主要入参 | 出参 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `memory_save` | `title`（≤80 字符）、`body`、`scope?`（`project` \| `global`）、`tags?`、`confidence?` | `id`、`path`、`scope` | 缺省 `project`；正文像凭证时拒绝写入 |
| `memory_search` | `query`、`scope?`（`both` \| `project` \| `global`）、`limit?` | 命中列表（带片段） | 词法打分：标题×3、标签×2、正文×1，中文按二元组切分；`limit` 缺省 8、上限 50 |
| `memory_get` | `id` | 完整记录 | 找不到就报错，不返回空 |
| `memory_list` | `scope?` | 标题索引行 | 只列标题，不读正文 |
| `memory_forget` | `id` | `archivedPath` | 把文件移进 `.archive/`，移回即恢复 |
dsh-memory-lite README · 工具：`memory_get` 与 `memory_forget` 只能触达当前工作区加 `global` 的记忆；其它工作区的 id 读不到也归档不了。

dsh-memory-lite README · 工作区隔离：- 项目键 = `sha256(normalizePath(cwd)).slice(0, 12)`。`normalizePath` 会把盘符转小写、`\` 转 `/`、折叠重复分隔符、去掉末尾分隔符，不解析 symlink；因此改目录名等于换了个新项目。
- 同一目录下的会话共享同一批 project 记忆。
- 换目录后，那些 project 记忆搜不到、按 id 也读不到。
- `global` 记忆所有工作区可见；把 `allowGlobalScope` 设为 `false` 可以禁止写入。

dsh-memory-lite README · 配置：| 键 | 默认值 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `vaultPath` | `<DSH_HOME>/memory-vault`（未设 `DSH_HOME` 时为 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\memory-vault`） | 记忆库根目录 |
| `injectStanding` | `true` | 是否注入常驻标题索引 |
| `standingMaxItems` | `8` | 常驻段最多几条（下限 1） |
| `standingBudgetChars` | `1200` | 常驻段字符预算（下限 200） |
| `allowGlobalScope` | `true` | 是否允许 `memory_save` 写 `global` |
| `redactSecrets` | `true` | 拒绝正文命中凭证模式（`api_key`、`secret`、`password`、`token`、私钥块）的写入 |
| `maxFileBytes` | `65536` | 单条记忆上限（下限 1024） |
| `autoSavePolicy` | `off` | 是否注册「写入策略」系统提示段，提示 agent 主动保存值得记的事实。`hint` 开启，`off` 不注册 |
dsh-memory-lite README · 配置：配置通过 `cordis.patch.yml` 生效：可以用插件自带的那份，也可以在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 末尾追加 id-targeted patch。没写出的键回落到上表的 schema 默认值。

dsh-memory-lite README · 磁盘格式：vault 是个普通目录：

```
<vault>/
  global/
    <slug>-<id>.md            全局记忆，所有工作区可见
  projects/

一条记忆就是一个带 YAML front matter 的 Markdown 文件：

```markdown
---

写入走「临时文件 + fsync + rename」，中途崩溃最多丢这一次写入，不会留下半截文件。超过 `maxFileBytes` 直接拒绝，不静默截断。`memory_forget` 把文件移进 `.archive/` 并补记 `archivedAt`，移回原处即恢复。没有索引文件：列表和检索每次都直接读 `.md` 文件，也就没有需要重建或可能损坏的派生数据。

dsh-memory-lite README · 设计取舍：- **永远零网络。** 插件从不外联。`test/offline.test.ts` 在运行时打桩 `fetch`、`http.request`、`https.request`、`net.connect`、`dns.lookup`，并断言调用次数为零。
- **无索引、无数据库。** 一切从文件本身推导。部件更少、无需维护，任何编辑器都能查看 vault。
- **归档而非删除。** 忘记可逆，适合长期记忆。
- **只做词法检索。** 不用 embedding，少假召回，代价是同义词召回弱。
- **常驻段是索引不是内容。** 注入文本明确声明记忆是数据不是指令，正文一律用 `memory_get` 取。
- **编译产物随仓库提交。** 仓库里带 `lib/`，从 git 安装不需要构建步骤。

dsh-memory-lite README · 限制：- 词法检索：无语义匹配，同义词召回弱。
- 改项目目录名后，旧记忆留在旧键下（文件还在，`project.json` 记录旧路径）。
- 没有 update 工具：要更新就存一条新的、归档旧的。
- 不做跨机同步；vault 是本地目录，需要同步请自行处理。
- `engines.dsh` 锁窄区间；DSH 升级超出 `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.2.2` 后 bundle 会被跳过，先改区间再升级（见 [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md)）。

dsh-memory-lite README · 开发：```powershell
pnpm install      # 装依赖
pnpm typecheck    # tsc --noEmit
pnpm test         # vitest run
pnpm build        # tsc -p tsconfig.json -> lib/

`test/offline.test.ts` 会打桩 `fetch`、`http.request`、`https.request`、`net.connect`、`dns.lookup` 后运行整个插件，断言五者一次都没被调用。其余套件覆盖路径规范化与项目键、slug 生成、frontmatter 往返、原子写不留 `.tmp-` 残留、归档、检索排序、跨工作区按 id 拒绝 `get`/`forget`、工具契约，以及常驻段的 3+5 选取与预算裁剪。
